fields.title: Kyōin Menjo Shōsho (Teacher Qualification Certificate)
fields.issuer: Balikpapan Shū Chōkan / Kyōiku Bu (District Education Bureau)
fields.remarks: Certificate re-issued under the military occupation administration to verify qualified teaching personnel for public school operations.

claims.fact: Sertifikat akademik membuktikan status kualifikasi resmi pemohon sebagai pengajar yang sah di bawah administrasi sekolah.
